analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price($578.02) vs SMA5($570.87)/SMA20($575.77)/SMA50($592.14): Trading above SMA5 and SMA20, below SMA50, indicating short-term bounce followed by resistance.
· Position vs SMA100($607.10)/SMA200($622.00): Persistent downward pressure from medium to long-term trends.
· 52-Week Position(21.3%): Recovering from lows but still at a low level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.7 → 49.6): Attempting to establish in neutral territory after exiting oversold, with limited room for further upside.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-4.2264 → 1.9123): Improving from negative territory, but trend reversal signal is weak.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper $611.40 / Middle $575.77 / Lower $540.14): Sideways movement around the middle band, lacking clear direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support($577.07): Short-term support based on Pivot Point($575.91).
· Swing Resistance($599.66): Resistance zone near SMA50 and the 5-day high($593.34).
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern: Forming a Higher Low (5-day low $546.30 > 20-day low $537.27), signaling recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.93): Slightly below the 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Continued sideways movement within an accumulation phase; consider buying on confirmation of support at $577.07.
